description: Read the processing status of an event submitted with mba_send_agent_event. Status is one of request_received, processing, sent, failed, skipped or success; failed and skipped carry error_message and skipped_reason. This is the only way to find out whether an accepted event actually reached the consumer.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_agent_event
title: Read agent event status
